name: Searchable Index
description: The editor MUST build and maintain a searchable index so users and agents can navigate and search while keeping memory bounded. Full indexing SHOULD be available almost instantly for typical model homes. Minimum index coverage MUST include: card type, card subtype, card ID, card name, outbound link adjacency, and attribute property names. Indexing MUST update on save; index updates are asynchronous, expected to be inexpensive, and SHOULD not block the UI thread. Full-text search is optional.
